description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the Land in Ja-Ela, Ja-Ela D/S Division, Gampaha District - Amendment  tot he Gaz. Ex. No. 1984/19 of 13.09.2016, land acquire for Yahalathenna Water Project
categorisation: The gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for a public infrastructure project (sewerage pipe lines project). It specifically describes the acquisition of immovable property, provides detailed land boundaries, location details (village, division, district), and extent of land (24.75 Perches). While it mentions a minister's name and authority under an Act, the core subject matter is land acquisition and property description, making it a Land Gazette under Type 4.
